ValidationRule.description: VR-ACC-03: Prevents billing address change after Finance Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(BillingStreet), ISCHANGED(BillingCity), ISCHANGED(BillingPostalCode), ISCHANGED(BillingCountry)), Entity_Locked__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Registered address cannot be changed after Finance Approval. Contact Finance to re-run the approval process.
